# AerisQ

> AerisQ is an engineering studio that builds production-grade AI agents, RAG systems, and internal enterprise software, and engineers MVP infrastructure for startups and scaleups. Based in Prague, Czech Republic (engineers also in Berlin).

## What we do
- AI Integration & Adaptation: custom RAG pipelines, autonomous business agents, secure local LLM deployment (e.g. Llama 3 on private infrastructure).
- Startup MVP Engine (0→1): rapid prototyping on Next.js, TypeScript, Python, and Supabase, architected to withstand VC technical due diligence.
- High-Performance Enterprise Software: legacy tech-debt refactoring, complex API orchestration, cloud-scale infrastructure.

## How we work
1. Paid Discovery Phase (1–2 weeks): technical audit, fixed-price architecture blueprint, fee credited back on project sign-off.
2. Core Engineering & Sprint Delivery: bi-weekly deployment reviews on live Vercel staging environments.
3. Deployment & SLA Infrastructure: production rollout in isolated secure cloud environments, team training, continuous monitoring.

## Guarantees
- GDPR & data privacy: no client data used to train public models; isolated or on-premise deployment.
- RAG responses are strictly grounded in a client's own verified documents (no hallucination by design).
- First working prototype (PoC) delivered within 14 days of kickoff.
